subject: Re: Quick demo — can we break into compact slots during FY freeze?
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@cormack.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <thargreaves@cormack.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro and demo request — timing constraints in Sept

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick follow-up after the briefing last week. We’re interested in a concise technical demo for our platform team (CTO + 2 engineers) but wanted to flag two constraints on our side: 1) the CFO has put a temporary spend freeze while Q3 budgets are revalidated (expected to unblock mid-September), and 2) our CTO is on a roadshow 9/9–9/10 with limited contiguous blocks.

Would Redwood be open to running a set of short, focused 15–20 minute demo slots (one per topic: architecture, cost modeling, and integration) over two days instead of a single 60–90 minute session? That would let us brief the execs and engineering teams separately while we wait on procurement.

I’ve attached a short Q3 budget summary to show the gating timeline.

Best,
Elena
Elena Morales
Director, Platform Engineering
Cormack Systems

Attachment: Cormack_Q3_budget_stub.xlsx
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@cormack.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Tom Hargreaves <thargreaves@cormack.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro and demo request — timing constraints in Sept

Elena — thanks for the heads up and for the budget note. We can absolutely accommodate compact slots. Proposal: three 20-minute sessions spread across two days. Each session will have a single focus and a clear CTA so your procurement and execs can sign off quicker once the freeze lifts.

Proposed plan (flexible):
- Day 1 (9/9): 11:30–11:50 — Architecture & deployment options (for CTO + infra)
- Day 1 (9/9): 15:00–15:20 — Cost controls & Optimize features (for Finance & FinOps)
- Day 2 (9/10): 10:00–10:20 — Integration & pilot steps (for engineering leads)

I’ll hold those tentative slots on my calendar and send short agendas. If any of those times clash with the roadshow, we can swap to early morning 8:00–8:20 PT windows — we’re flexible. I’ll also include a one-page mutual action plan that ties each session to the procurement milestone (PO, security checklist, timeline).

Attaching an updated demo deck that maps to the 3 micro-sessions.

–Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood_demo-deck-v2.pdf
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-07T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: scheduling + SE availability

Steph — noted. I can own the Architecture and Integration slots (9/9 11:30 & 9/10 10:00). Lauren, can you cover the Cost controls slot or should I bring FinOps snippets?

Also: if procurement is frozen, we should surface the PO timeline and alternatives (e.g., short pilot with a credit hold) in the Cost session. I’ll prep a 2-slide cost deltas comparison for quantized vs full precision inference to make the decision tradeoffs explicit.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Hargreaves <thargreaves@cormack.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, Elena Morales <elena@cormack.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Cormack Procurement <procurement@cormack.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro and demo request — timing constraints in Sept

Stephanie — thanks for the quick turnaround. The overall plan looks good; a couple of notes from procurement and exec calendar:
- CFO wants a 15–minute executive snapshot (high level cost + SLA) before any technical deep dives. If possible, can you include a 15-minute exec summary on 9/9 at 09:00 PT?
- Procurement confirms the spend freeze may lift between 9/13–9/16. We’ll need a mutual action plan that maps each micro-session to the procurement checklist so approvals are fast once the freeze is lifted.

If a short exec snapshot is possible, we can keep the other three micro-sessions later in the day.

Tom Hargreaves
VP, Infrastructure
Cormack Systems
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hargreaves <thargreaves@cormack.com>, Elena Morales <elena@cormack.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Cormack Procurement <procurement@cormack.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro and demo request — timing constraints in Sept

Tom/Elena — yes, we can do the 15-minute exec snapshot on 9/9 at 09:00 PT. Updated schedule below; I’ll publish calendar invites and short agendas (5 bullets each) and include the MAP and procurement checklist link. Action items: 
- Karthik: 2-slide exec cost + SLA snapshot for 9/9 09:00 PT
- Lauren: 10-minute procurement checklist review during Cost controls slot (9/9 15:00 PT)
- Steph: send MAP + DocuSign pilot agreement template to procurement and HubSpot link to the deal record

Once procurement confirms the unblock window, we’ll push for a PO commit. For now I’ve set invites to tentative to keep calendars clean.

Thanks — looking forward to making this efficient for your teams.

—Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
